messages:
Anna Li: Heads up — Newport asked for a short joint perf run next week to validate perf/W gains from our quant+kernel tweaks before the marketplace announcement. Primary asks: 1) steady-state tokens/sec, 2) perf/W at 50% and 100% load, 3) P95 latency targets. Can we lock a 4-6 hour window and owners?
Sam Rao: I'm thinking a small matrix: model (llama-13b / gptj-6b), seq (512/1024), batch (1/4), quant (8/4/4+kv cache), kernel knobs (baseline / tuned). Goal is a quick compare, not every combo. Suggest throughput sweep at batch sizes 1,4 and a power sweep at 50%/100% utilization.
Diego Mendez: I can lead kernel tuning. For Newport we'll need kernel source versions and their perf driver build tags. Diego: propose param set: 
```
KERN_FLAGS=("--sched=compact" "--sm_clock=2100" "--l2_policy=aggressive" "--kv_cache_prefetch=1")
```
We'll run A/B on only the top 3 promising flags to save time. Who's our contact at Newport to coordinate driver builds?
Keisha Patel: I have Newport ops contact (will DM). For schedule: canary run in us-west-2 on Tue 09:00-15:00 PST, full sweep Wed 02:00-08:00 PST (off-peak for both teams). Measurement scripts live at s3://redwood-bench/newport/2026-03-boarding/ and runners at infra/redwood/bench/run_bench.py. Output schema: results/<job>/metrics.csv + power/<job>/power.csv.
bench-bot: deploy-bench triggered by Anna Li — job id nj-345 started on cluster: rg-dedicated-usw2; loadgen command: `./run_loadgen --model=gptj-6b --seq=1024 --batch=1 --iter=2000 --quant=4` 
Sam Rao: OK I'll prep the spreadsheet with the matrix and expected columns (throughput, p50/p95 latency, avg watt, perf_per_watt). link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcD_newport_bench_sprint (will share edit perms) :white_check_mark:
Diego Mendez: Telemetry note — power should be sampled at >=10Hz and synced to tokens emitted. We'll add a sync marker using `bench-sync --mark start` at run start. CSV header example: 
```
timestamp,device_id,watts,tokens_emitted
2026-03-25T09:00:01Z,dev-01,520.4,10234
```
Keisha Patel: I'll confirm Newport will expose power sensors and a build environment for the tuned kernel. Also will arrange a short pre-run call Mon 16:00 PST with Newport eng + our tuning team.
Anna Li: Great — owners: Sam (matrix + report), Diego (kernel experiments), Keisha (partner coordination & infra access). Deliverables: raw CSVs in S3, a 1-page summary (perf/W delta + recommended knobs), and a short slack write-up for announcement folks. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @keisha. Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 PST if that works for everyone? :calendar:
Sam Rao: Works for me.
Diego Mendez: Works. Will push initial tuned kernel branch to infra/kernel/branches/newport-tune by EOD today.
Keisha Patel: Confirmed with Newport ops — they can do the sensor exports and will join Mon call. I'll post the meeting invite. :thumbsup:
